changes_made.explanation: This paper does NOT address NLG tasks - it focuses on data collection methods for NLU tasks (intent classification and slot-filling). The paper uses Accuracy for intent classification and F1 for slot-filling to evaluate model performance on the collected data. These metrics are correctly extracted and normalized.
No LLMs are used as judges in this paper. The paper was published in 2020 before LLM-as-judge methodologies became common.
